source: Good Sam directory (PUBLIC_PARK and local-named rows with no entry within 2 km) and every named OSM tourism=camp_site/caravan_site with no entry within 1.5 km, read by name
note: Local-gap pass, eastern states westward. No local-government RV campground is missing in Maine: the one Good Sam public park (Mattawamkeag Wilderness Park) is held as 4180, and the OSM local candidates are seasonal-only (Salmon Point), residents-only (Mullin's Head), a donation town site with no web presence (Jonesport) or water-trail tent sites. The ~150 other unmatched named OSM campgrounds are private - the private gap in Maine is large and is outside this pass.

excluded.name: Salmon Point Campground (Town of Bridgton)
excluded.why: town lists it as 'Seasonal only' (bridgtonmaine.org), all sites booked by seasonals with a waiting list

excluded.name: Mullin's Head Campground (Town of North Haven)
excluded.why: island park by ferry; permission only via a North Haven taxpayer or resident, carry-in/carry-out (northhavenmaine.org)

excluded.name: Parkman Point / Estey / Frenchman Bay Conservancy sites
Jonesport Campground (Town of Jonesport, Henry Point)
excluded.why: no live web presence: donation-based, no operator page with rates/phone and no bookable listing (live-presence rule)

held.name: Mattawamkeag Wilderness Park Campground
held.why: already id 4180; Good Sam pin 6.4 km off

other.name: (private gap)
other.why: ~150 unmatched named OSM campgrounds in ME are private (Bayley's, Wolfe's Neck, Thomas Point Beach, Sea-Vu, etc.) - private gap is large, outside this pass
